## Description

Fits Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) to return series tail extremes to model Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES), dynamically buying out-of-the-money puts when tail risk probabilities spike.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, volatile geopolitical events, systemic credit dislocation.

## Vehicles

Tail-risk hedge funds, institutional pension funds, risk-parity funds.

## Required data

Long-term historical daily return distributions, index option implied volatility skew.

## Caveats

Tail options decay continuously during long bull runs (negative carry cost); timing entry windows is paramount.
